shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the right-hand mark at (5,1) on the left with the mark at 2 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(5)=1. Right image: The displayed set excludes 2 at its lower bound.
Rationales: On the left, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate. On the right, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray.
